world_news_real.title: US unveils sanctions on ICC in move court condems as 'assault on rule of law'
world_news_real.description: The European Union described the move against the International Criminal Court as "deeply regrettable".

world_news_real.title: Navi Pillay, former UN human rights chief, wins Nobel Peace Prize
world_news_real.description: Pillay is recognised for her "efforts to promote peace and international law", the Norwegian Nobel Committee says.

world_news_real.title: Firing squad execution to be livestreamed, Pentagon says
world_news_real.description: Pete Hegseth says the execution will be public, but a legal expert says the "unprecedented" decision is on "uncertain legal terrain".

world_news_real.title: Russian search engine Yandex struggles after Ukrainian strikes on data centres
world_news_real.description: Often dubbed "Russia's Google", the tech firm admits customers may experience disruption to digital services due to the attacks.

world_news_real.title: Thieves steal 30,000 bottles of wine worth €5m in Italy, reports say
world_news_real.description: The heist at the Florence-based winery is believed to be one of the largest thefts of its kind in Italy.

world_news_real.title: Man named Hitler Mussolini elected mayor in Peru
world_news_real.description: The left-wing candidate won a narrow victory in a remote district in the Peruvian Andes, exit polls show.

world_news_real.title: Ethiopia warns Eritrea it will defend itself after troops cross border
world_news_real.description: Truckloads of Eritrean soldiers have been seen driving into Ethiopia, which has reportedly responded with drone strikes.

world_news_real.title: US immigration officials defend ICE agents who shot man in same car as child
world_news_real.description: Oscar Belgal, the 28-year-old man, survived the shooting and is now being held at a detention facility outside of New York, officials said.

world_news_real.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire speaks to BBC
world_news_real.description: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.

world_news_real.title: France promises 3,000 extra teachers in first step to calm student protests
world_news_real.description: Education minister Edouard Geffray makes the offer after another day of sometimes violent demonstrations by high-school students.
